interface.scenario: UIREQ-023 scenario 2 (Midnight stagenet end-to-end qualification); scenario 1 keeps its --native-inventory interface
interface.record: committed JSON {format:'moriarty-sherlock-native-qualification/1', source:{path (committed draft .mori with a closed entry), sha256}, pins:{network:'stagenet', ledger_version:'9', node_version, toolchain, relation_id (sha256 of relation_vk_path bytes), relation_vk_path (committed)}, stages:{compile:{status,...}, prove:{status, prover,...}, verify:{status, verifier (not the prover)}, deploy:{status, tx (64-hex), address}, call:{status, tx, entry_point}, readback:{status, state_sha256 (sha256 of the indexed post-call contract state bytes), observed_result}}, claims:{execution_authority:'none', preview_fenrir_evidence_transferred:false}}; every stage status is 'run' or 'not-run'
interface.holdout: recomputes the source hash and relation_id; requires all six stages run (else SPEC GATE listing the not-run stages); requires the deploy and call transactions indexed once with SUCCESS on stagenet and hashing to their ids; requires the call to be a ContractCall at the deployed address with the recorded entry point; hashes the indexed post-call state; compares observed_result with the holdout's own mori simulate reference run of the committed source
interface.evaluator_note: Evaluator-authored (sherlock-eval 2026-10-25). No wallet is opened by the holdout; an unreachable indexer is host-unfit (exit 3). Ledger 9, node, SDK and proof server stay unchanged.
